Title: Azure SignalR Service support for ASP.NET is now available

Body.Content:
ASP.NET support for Azure SignalR Service is now available to the public. Use Azure SignalR Service with ASP.NET support for existing ASP.NET SignalR applications to scale real-time applications.

Learn more
